CustomField.description: Categorizes designations for filtering and reporting. Four values align to FASB ASU 2016-14 donor-restriction classifications (Without Donor Restriction, With Donor Restriction - Purpose / Time / Permanent). A fifth value, Earned Revenue, tags designations used for exchange-transaction revenue (fees, ticketing, workshop registrations, program service fees) so it can be separated from contribution revenue in reports.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How the donor restricted the use of this designation's funds. Without Donor Restriction: usable for any program at any time. With Donor Restriction - Purpose: must be spent on a specific program or use. With Donor Restriction - Time: released only after a specified date or event. With Donor Restriction - Permanent: principal held indefinitely (endowment); only earnings are spendable. Earned Revenue: exchange-transaction revenue from selling goods or providing services — not a donor contribution.
CustomField.label: Restriction Type
